entries.summary: compileStylesheet emits .cms-el-* > * { text-align } so inner module wrappers cannot override Design. Blurb site.css no longer centers images with margin:auto; images are inline-block so they follow text-align. Default .cms-mod-blurb { text-align:center } remains when Design align is unset.
Live CSS uses the same child selector. Heading/text/CTA/button/testimonial/icon-list did not hardcode text-align.
No schema change. text_align was already in layout_json; public CSS stays derived at render time.
